added_findings.title: VV share links: a bare project code is ambiguous, and TV's link builder rejects VV's usual ?project= value
added_findings.detail:
Two problems with porting TV's share links to VV unchanged.

The code collides. 13 VV numeric project codes are shared by two or three projects (schemes) in the master index: 3038 (Gordon Scheme-03/-04), 55164, 56662, 57994, 59908, 61511, 61721, 61922, 62104 (three Fenner schemes), 62361, 63568, 63578 (Yates Orangery/Porch) and 63592. LookupIndexEntry resolves a bare code to one of them: the newest year wins, and on a tie the later index entry wins. Sheet ids repeat across projects, so ?project=3038&open=Sheet_004 can silently open the other scheme's drawing.

VV's ?project= is normally the folderId. Whitecardopedia opens VV with ?project=<folderId>, and VV's own R2 rule requires that form. TV's Na__LeShareLink__CurrentProject keeps the raw GetProjectCodeFromUrl() only if it matches CODE_PATTERN ^[A-Za-z0-9]{2,12}$. '2026/3047__Doous' fails, so UrlFor returns '' and every Share button hands out no link in a session opened from Whitecardopedia.
added_findings.recommendation:
Decide D-S08-13. Carry the folderId (canonical and unique) or the folder name without the year as the project token: <VV live app URL>?project={folderId}&open={documentKey}. Adapt Share__Links:
- CurrentProject: take the resolved folderId; use the index entry's projectCode for display only.
- Replace CODE_PATTERN with a project-token pattern that admits '/', '_', '-', '.' and the three space-containing legacy folders.
- Replace the NA built-in floor.

Keep the document keys and the open parameter verbatim. Trade-off for Adam: a folderId link breaks if the project is later renamed; a code link survives renames but is ambiguous for 13 codes.
added_findings.evidence: WCP/02__Src__AppModules/03__AppData/Na__MasterIndex__ProjectLocations__.json (152 entries, 138 codes, 13 shared); VVM/03__AppUtils/Na__AppUtils__ProjectLoader.js:196-201 (byCode, newest year wins, ties to later entry), :319-322 (GetProjectCodeFromUrl = raw ?project=); WCP/02__Src__AppModules/61__Feature__PwaAppHelpers/Na__Feature__PwaAppHelpers__ValeVisionLinkRouting__Logic__.js:53 and 11__Feature__ProjectViewer/Na__Feature__ProjectViewer__ImageCarousel.jsx:95 (?project=<folderId>); VV/.cursor/rules/08-R2IndexArchitecture--ValeVision3D-SSOT-.mdc:15; TVM/51__System__LayoutEditor/66__Feature__DocumentSharing/Na__LayoutEditor__Share__Links__.js:119 (CODE_PATTERN), :125-129 (NA floor), :309-317 (CurrentProject), :357-362 (UrlFor)
added_findings.vv_adaptation: Project token = the folderId (or folder name), with a pattern admitting '/', '_', '-', '.' and the legacy space names. CurrentProject reads the resolved folderId. NA built-in floor replaced. Keys and open parameter verbatim.

added_findings.title: VV ResolveAssetUrl sends 11 projects to GitHub Pages only; the published reader must build its R2 URL itself
added_findings.detail: VV's Na__AppUtils__ResolveAssetUrl returns { primary: ghUrl, fallback: ghUrl } whenever the project's master-index entry has hasImages_R2 === false. 11 of the 152 entries carry that flag; all are 2025 projects, for example 2025/BL-61732__Ball. TV's Urls__.For resolves every published path through ResolveAssetUrl. Ported that way, VV's reader would look for published files only on GitHub Pages, where they are never committed (D-S08-08 (a)). Every drawing of those projects would show the grey 'could not be loaded' mask on the live site.
added_findings.recommendation: In the VV Na__PubDoc__Urls__.For seam, build the R2 URL directly from the configured R2 base (Na__AppUtils__R2BaseUrl / AppConfig ProjectData__AssetUrls__R2BaseUrl) plus the project-relative path, ignoring hasImages_R2. Put GitHub Pages second. Do not hard-code the CDN string (VV rule 08, line 79). Add an acceptance check that a hasImages_R2:false project resolves its published index to R2 first.
added_findings.vv_adaptation: R2 URL from the configured base; images flag ignored for published paths

added_decisions.question: Which project token does a VV Share link carry?
added_decisions.options: (a) The folderId, e.g. '2026/3047__Doous'. It is VV's canonical key and unique, and it is what Whitecardopedia and the VV R2 rule use. It breaks if the project is later renamed. (b) The folder name without the year, e.g. '3047__Doous'. It is unique today and LookupIndexEntry resolves it. It also breaks on rename. (c) The bare numeric code. It survives renames, but 13 VV codes are shared by 2-3 schemes, so a link can open the wrong project.
added_decisions.recommendation: (a) or (b). Never (c) while codes collide. Whichever is chosen, adapt Share__Links CurrentProject, CODE_PATTERN and the built-in floor, and keep the document keys and the open parameter verbatim.

added_decisions.question: Where do VV sheet pictures live? Published sheets point at them, so this must equal S07a's D-S07a-07.
added_decisions.options: (a) TV's 05__Layout__DrawingDocs__Images/<DocumentId>/ directly under the project folder, beside 06__Layout__PublishedDocuments. 65, 52, 53 and the tests stay verbatim. (b) S07a's LayoutEditor/SheetImages/<DocumentId>/. VV must then change Na__LePubSheet__IMAGES_DIR (Publish__Sheet:81) and the schema test's expectation (Na__Test__PublishedSchema__ :443).
added_decisions.recommendation: (a), for consistency with D-S08-01 (a) (TV names at the project root). If (b) is kept, it is a one-constant VV seam; the reader resolves any '/../<path>' generically.

notes:
The slice is strong. Every one of the 48 findings rests on a true observation, so nothing is refuted. I checked all 18 critical and high findings against source. Line references are accurate to within a few lines, and every TV/VV devlog version cited is where the index puts it. A full search of VVM found no equivalent the survey missed.

The two critical findings stand:
- F01: VV's viewer still renders every 2D underlay live on the reader's device and builds PDFs there.
- F02: the Whitecardopedia sync purge would delete published files. It is also live today for 25 mirrored thumbnails and 18 snapshots. These are committed to git, so the app degrades to a GitHub Pages fallback rather than breaking.

Material errors corrected:
1. Share links: porting Share__Links verbatim would hand out no link at all in a VV session opened from Whitecardopedia, because VV's ?project= is the folderId and TV's CODE_PATTERN rejects it. A bare-code link is also unsafe, because 13 VV codes are shared by 2-3 schemes. New decision D-S08-13.
2. Identity in published data: Publish__Sheet and Share__Links were marked verbatim or header-only, but they write NA identity (Meta__SchemaRef, 'Published by TrueVision', the NA s/ fallback URL, a 'Noble Architecture' share title) into client-facing R2 data and links.
3. hasImages_R2 trap (missed): VV's ResolveAssetUrl sends 11 projects to GitHub Pages only.
4. PdfExporter version numbers are app-specific: VV 1.2.0 is TV 1.3.0's change.
5. The 'Vale typeface' question has a direct answer. --Vale_FontFamily is Open Sans in every Vale app, and VV already loads the AD04 Open Sans TTFs, so no new font files are needed. Re-flow risk is low because Open Sans sets narrower than the Helvetica VV measures with today.

Watch for the planner:
- Run WP-S08-04 (purge fix) first, independent of publishing.
- Make the four cross-slice decisions in one gate (WP-S08-15): font, document id = D-S03b-01, link token, and sheet-image folder = D-S07a-07, which currently conflicts with the publisher's hard-coded 05__Layout__DrawingDocs__Images.
- Give single owners to the ModeController/SheetSurface/DocumentId/scene-ready seams, which S03a, S03b, S07a and S09 also specify.
- Land WP-S08-03 (fonts) before the first real publish, because published text is line-broken with the authoring face.
- When searching VVM, exclude VVM/62__Feature__EmailWorkers/CloudflareWorker/node_modules: it sits inside 02__Src__AppModules and floods greps.
